user.title: Add a Luck Jingle printer
user.description: Select your printer model. Keep the printer powered on and nearby while Home Assistant discovers it over Bluetooth LE. Network printing is optional and requires a Home Assistant access token on clients.

select_adapter.title: Select Bluetooth adapter
select_adapter.description: Choose Automatic to let Home Assistant select a source, or select the Bluetooth source that sees this printer.

error.printer_not_found: The printer was not found over BLE. Turn it on, move it near Home Assistant, and try again.
error.bluetooth_adapter_not_found: That Bluetooth source is no longer available for this printer. Select another source or Automatic.

init.title: Printer options
init.description: Choose the Bluetooth source, authenticated HTTP print relay, and connection behavior for this printer.

data.keep_connection_alive: Keep Bluetooth connection open between print jobs

error.bluetooth_adapter_not_found: That Bluetooth source is no longer available for this printer. Select another source or Automatic.
